step1_analysis.description: A dynamic latch comparator typically used in a successive approximation register (SAR) ADC. It uses a clocked tail current source and precharge transistors to evaluate the differential input and output a digital decision, consuming zero static power.

paper_reference.title: An Ultralow-Energy ADC for Smart Dust

sky130_expected.calculation: Integrate VDD * I(VDD) over one clock cycle.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The comparator is only a small part of the ADC's 31pJ total energy. In SKY130 at 1.8V, a single dynamic comparison typically consumes hundreds of femtojoules.

standby_power.description: Power consumption when the comparator is inactive (clock low).

sky130_expected.calculation: Average VDD * I(VDD) during the precharge phase.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by subthreshold leakage of the OFF transistors (tail NMOS and precharge PMOS). SKY130 typical leakage is in the pW to nW range depending on device sizing.

evaluation_delay.description: Time from the rising edge of the clock to the output crossing VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Measure time difference between CLK rising to 0.9V and OUT rising to 0.9V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the input differential voltage. With a 100mV difference, delay is typically a few nanoseconds in 130nm.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the dynamic comparator's evaluation delay, energy per operation, and standby power across two cycles with alternating input polarities.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dynamic Comparator Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

XM1 VDD N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 LABEL_NET_4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N3 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N3 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Clock signals: Active high for tail (LABEL_NET_4), active low for precharge (LABEL_NET_0, 3)
VCLK_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 pulse(0 1.8 100n 1n 1n 400n 1u)
VCLK_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 pulse(0 1.8 100n 1n 1n 400n 1u)
VCLK_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 pulse(0 1.8 100n 1n 1n 400n 1u)

* Differential inputs
VINP LABEL_NET_1 0 pwl(0 0.95 0.9u 0.95 1.1u 0.85 2u 0.85)
VINN LABEL_NET_2 0 pwl(0 0.85 0.9u 0.85 1.1u 0.95 2u 0.95)

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
tran 1n 2u

* Measure delays for Cycle 1 (INP > INN)
meas tran delay_outp_c1 trig v(LABEL_NET_4) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N4) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran delay_outn_c1 trig v(LABEL_NET_4) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 rise=1

* Measure delays for Cycle 2 (INP < INN)
meas tran delay_outp_c2 trig v(LABEL_NET_4) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(N4) val=0.9 rise=2
meas tran delay_outn_c2 trig v(LABEL_NET_4) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(N3) val=0.9 rise=2

* Measure final states to verify correctness
meas tran v_outp_c1 find v(N4) at=200n
meas tran v_outn_c1 find v(N3) at=200n
meas tran v_outp_c2 find v(N4) at=1.2u
meas tran v_outn_c2 find v(N3) at=1.2u

* Measure energy and power
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=2u
let energy_per_cycle = -avg_current * 1.8 * 1u
print energy_per_cycle

meas tran standby_current avg i(VVDD) from=600n to=900n
let standby_power = -standby_current * 1.8
print standby_power

quit
.endc
